name: 1 Click = 1 Grow! 💪
desc:
🐣 EASTER EVENT IS HERE!

💪 Grow stronger, rebirth, hatch powerful pets, and explore the limited-time Easter content.

The bunnies have arrived! Jump into the Easter Zone, collect seasonal pets, and compete for the top spot on the leaderboards.

🌟 Features:
🐣 Hatch and combine pets
💥 Rebirth for huge multipliers
🐰 Easter Zone rewards
🥚 Limited event eggs and pets
🏖️ AFK Zone with passive rewards
🏆 Leaderboards and PvP
🎁 Codes, quests, and more rewards

📘 How to Play:
💪 Click to gain strength
🏆 Earn wins as you progress
🐣 Buy eggs for stronger pets
🔁 Rebirth to multiply your power
🚀 Unlock better zones and keep scaling

💡 More updates soon.
🐛 Found a bug? Use the Bug Report menu in-game.
